operative_context: Billing display simplifications or currency presentation adjustments must not silently override core pricing logic or create mismatches between stored and displayed totals
The system shall maintain separation between billing calculation/storage logic and presentation-layer formatting
exceptions: Currency conversion and display format may be treated as presentation-layer conventions in pilot scenarios, but only if underlying financial records remain authoritative and unmodified
conflicts_or_obsolete: Display-friendly simplifications that produce visible mismatches between stored and presented totals are not acceptable
Operational display simplifications that cause customer-visible totals to no longer align with underlying financial records violate the separation principle
notes: TARGET_ID R72 addresses the critical separation between billing display and storage. PRIMARY evidence E1 provides rent lifecycle context. E4 explicitly warns against situations where operational display becomes simpler but customer-visible totals no longer align with underlying financial records.
